latest_release.name: v0.3.0 — Street Level, On Your Phone, in Your Language
latest_release.body: v0.3.0 brings God's Eye View down to the street, into your pocket and into three new languages. Open street-level photos from four providers without leaving the globe, use the app on a phone with a layout built for it, and read the interface in Spanish, Russian or Simplified Chinese. Short share links, a rebuilt voice assistant, your own map files, GNSS interference and aircraft emergencies, ten new camera packs and about thirty new bikeshare systems come with it. ## Street Level See the street from the globe (Cameras ▸ Street Level). Coverage lines drape on the terrain and Google 3D tiles; click a street and the nearest photo opens in the panel, flat or 360°, with view cones along its sequence and ‹ › to step through it. - **Four providers, one at a time**: **Panoramax** and **KartaView**, which need no key at all, **Mapillary** with a free client token, and **Google Street View** on the Google 3D map with your Google Maps key. - Every caption names the photo's author and licence and links to the original. - Filter by 360° or flat imagery and by capture date; share links remember the provider and filters. - Host apps can compose their own provider list, and point Mapillary at a server-side Graph endpoint so no token reaches the page. ## On your phone On screens 720 px wide and narrower, the globe stays full screen and a bottom tab bar (Layers, Cameras, Context, Search, More) opens one panel sheet at a time. Swipe a sheet down to close it. - Pinch zoom is three times as responsive, aircraft and ships are easier to tap, and opening Context shows the aircraft you are tracking. - Add it to your home screen: the app ships a web app manifest and icons, so it installs with the God's Eye View mark instead of a blank tile. ## In your language The interface now speaks **Spanish**, **Russian** and **Simplified Chinese**. Pick a language from the globe button in the bottom-right corner, or open the app with `?lang=es`, `?lang=ru` or `?lang=zh-CN`; by default it follows your browser. - Each language is one JSON file keyed by the English text, and `npm test` fails on missing or broken translations, so adding a language is a contained piece of work. ## Also in this release ### Short share links - The share button makes short `/share/` links. The code is a compact, versioned description of the view, so a link opens the same way on any copy of the app, including your own local install. - A link can follow an aircraft, military aircraft or satellite. If it has stopped reporting, the view opens at its last known position and says so. - A mistyped link is refused instead of opening the wrong view, and older long `#v=2` links keep working. - The codec is a package export, so a server can read share links, for example for link previews ([format](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/docs/SHARE-LINK-FORMAT.md)). ### Voice - **Answers you can trust.** Voice can turn on and query every data layer by its everyday name ("buses", "hurricanes", "military bases").
